notes.title: New keys added to the inventory
notes.notes:
Keyboard arrow keys were added to move through the inventory, making it more intuitive.

I'm very sorry if initially moving through the inventory caused problems.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
Fixed menu bug, and now trojan horses use a timer when complete the assignment, and always put the trojan horse in the box.

Sorry, if this ruined anyone's gaming experience.
